title: Wrong database password after a deploy
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the API component, the missing password configuration, and the deployment of version 2.3.2 as the trigger.
root_cause: The API container (shopapp/api:2.3.2) failed to authenticate to PostgreSQL because the required database password environment variable was missing or incorrect, introduced by the recent deployment of version 2.3.2, causing 503 errors on product pages.
truth: api 2.3.2 reads the database password from a new setting that was never filled in, so PostgreSQL rejects every login from the api.
check_first: Look at the API container logs or its status in Docker/Podman.
